name: Vigilant Commander 0.2 (power armour)
revision: 0.2 · power-armour rebuild: resin figure, helm, backpack and 32 mm base
description: The Vigil squad commander rebuilt in power armour: domed pauldrons with a raised rank chevron, barrel cuirass with the split-chevron emblem, high collar round the Marshal helm (swept blade crest, command antenna), abdominal lames, knee hydraulics and a command pack with a comms mast. Points the advance with the left gauntlet and raises the VW2-07 Culverin heavy revolver; cloth tabard over the leading leg. Helm and backpack are separate keyed parts; the 0.1 Warden stays in the catalogue.
buildNotes: Pose and skeleton from the 0.1 figure (same sockets, pegs and base); armour from tools/powerarmor.py, sized with unified-CAD-MCP miniature_power_armor_plan.
Helm from the 0.3 helm library (tools/helms04.py) and pack from tools/powerarmor.py, both through tools/morph.py print_safe_selective.
Quick printability screen only (unified-CAD-MCP miniature_printability_check, upright); no support plans or full certification yet.
limitations: Procedural sculpt; quick printability screen, not a test print or full check. No STEP reference.
